svg.title: A visible wingtip and two possible hidden extents
svg.desc: A real airplane and an aligned view with only its lower wingtip covered. Two illustrative lower edges have equal weight and the same mean as the visible edge. Not model predictions.
svg.metadata: Allegiant MD-83, UnfinishedPortraitmaker (CC BY 2.0), COCO val2017 545407. Cropped; right wingtip detail artificially occluded. https://www.flickr.com/photos/unfinishedportrait/7230915270/
